final_advisory.reasoning: The congestion is predicted because of the slow speeds in areas that feed into Downtown LA. Specifically, the NW of Downtown LA (sensor 717453) has a speed of 31.25 mph, which is slower than expected. Additionally, the Glendale/Burbank area (sensors 717582 and 718379) have speeds of 67.25 mph and 64.25 mph respectively, but these are still slower than the free-flowing traffic in other areas. The slowest speed contributing to this congestion is from the San Fernando Valley (sensor 769346), with a speed of 42.62 mph.

recommendations.action: Implement upstream metering on I-5/SR-134 interchange
recommendations.expected_effect: Reduced congestion in the NW of Downtown LA and Glendale/Burbank areas
